briefing.headline: PARA spikes 60% overnight amid thin trading
briefing.summary: All ten mega‑cap tech names slipped, pulling the core average down about 1.1% and dragging the SPY and QQQ lower. The breadth was narrow – only two advancers versus eight decliners – while a handful of niche tokens saw wild moves, led by PARA up 60% and DPC up 18%. Small‑cap and specialty tokens such as REZI, CDNL and DGII posted large declines, underscoring a risk‑off tone ahead of the US open.
